sections.shortTitle: N -W F P University of Engineering and Technology Amendment Act 1996
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

NORTH﷓WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND
TECHNOLOGY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER
PROVINCE UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
An Act further to amend the North‑West
Frontier Province, University of Engineering and Technology Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of N.‑W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 16th October, 1996]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis/96/17121, dated
16‑10‑1996.‑‑The North‑West Frontier Province
University of Engineering and Technology (Amendment) Bill, 1996, having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of the North‑West Frontier Province on
the 30th September, 1996 and assented to by the Governor of the North‑West
Frontier Province on the 14th October, 1996 is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Legislature of North‑West Frontier Province.
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Act may be called the North‑West
Frontier Province University of Engineering and Technology (Amendment) Act,
1996.

Amendment in section 14 of Ordinance XIII of 1980

NORTH﷓WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND
TECHNOLOGY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER
PROVINCE UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
An Act further to amend the North‑West
Frontier Province, University of Engineering and Technology Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of N.‑W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 16th October, 1996]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis/96/17121, dated
16‑10‑1996.‑‑The North‑West Frontier Province
University of Engineering and Technology (Amendment) Bill, 1996, having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of the North‑West Frontier Province on
the 30th September, 1996 and assented to by the Governor of the North‑West
Frontier Province on the 14th October, 1996 is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Legislature of North‑West Frontier Province.
2. Amendment in section 14 of
Ordinance XIII of 1980.‑‑In the North -West Frontier Province
University of Engineering and Technology Ordinance, 1980 (N.‑W.F.P.
Ordinance XIII of 1980), in section 14, in subsection (1),‑‑
(a) for clause (iv), the
following shall be substituted, namely:
"(iv) The Secretary to Government
of the North‑West Frontier, Education Department, or his nominee not
below the rank of an Additional Secretary; and
(b) after clause (iv), as so
substituted, the following new clauses shall be inserted, namely:
"(iva) The Secretary to
Government of the North‑West Frontier, Finance Department, or his nominee
not below the rank of an Additional Secretary;
(ivb) The Secretary to Government
of the North‑West Frontier, Services and General Administration
Department, or his nominee not below the rank of an Additional
Secretary;".
